name: Trans Goetia
source:
Trans Goetia is a 18+ gay little adventure of trans girl named Circe losing her brain cells from dealing with the mischief making demon Fufu. 

Circe gets introduced to the world of magic in exchange of being pestered as she gains squishy softness at a rate regular hormone therapy could never provide! Surely there are no demonic downsides!

[From [url=https://nadianova.itch.io/trans-goetia]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Trans Goetia》是一段18禁同性恋小冒险。跨性别女孩喀耳刻被爱捣乱的恶魔芙芙折腾得脑细胞都快不够用了。

喀耳刻接触到魔法世界，代价是得忍受对方不断纠缠，而她的身体也以常规激素治疗远远无法企及的速度，变得柔软丰润！这当然不会有什么恶魔式的副作用吧！

[摘自[url=https://nadianova.itch.io/trans-goetia]Itch.io[/url]]
